The *Saṁkilesikaduka* ("Dyad on Things Corruptible" or "Dyad on Objects of Defilements") is a canonical Abhidhamma text belonging to the *Paṭṭhāna* (*Duka-paṭṭhāna*), designated as Patthana 8.50 [SuttaCentral]. Within the Abhidhamma Piṭaka, the text applies the analytical apparatus of the twenty-four conditional relations (*paccaya*) to the dyad of phenomena that are corruptible or subject to defilements (*saṁkilesika dhamma*) versus those that are not [SuttaCentral]. The available secondary passages from U Kyaw Khine's translation do not treat this text directly, but rather discuss the corresponding analytical category in the *Nikkhepakaṇḍa* of the *Dhammasaṅgaṇī* [SuttaCentral].
No curated parallels in other Buddhist canonical traditions are identified for this text [SuttaCentral].
